# Women's Health Duo

> Holistic women's healthcare by two sisters: Dr. Charmi Shah (OB-GYN — obstetrics, gynecology, IVF, laparoscopy) and Dr. Zalak Shah (women's health physiotherapist and STOTT Pilates instructor for **Mat** and **Reformer**, including **Mat Pilates online**). **Primary access for international patients is online** (video OB-GYN, online physio / Pilates programs). **In person:** Dr. Charmi in **Mumbai** and **Ahmedabad**; Dr. Zalak in **Bangalore** and **Ahmedabad**—both offer **virtual** visits worldwide.
>
> **Entity line (brand ↔ doctors):** Women's Health Duo — Dr. Charmi Shah (OB-GYN / IVF) & Dr. Zalak Shah (women's health physio / STOTT Pilates).

## Summary

- **Brand:** Women's Health Duo
- **India:** In-person visits for Dr. Charmi in **Mumbai** and **Ahmedabad**; for Dr. Zalak in **Bangalore** and **Ahmedabad**; strong emphasis on **online** access for people anywhere.
- **Dr. Charmi Shah (OB-GYN):** Pregnancy and high-risk obstetrics, gynecology, IVF/IUI and fertility workup, laparoscopic surgery, PCOS, endometriosis, menopause, routine women's health — **online OB-GYN consults** available globally; in person in **Mumbai** and **Ahmedabad**.
- **Dr. Zalak Shah (physio & Pilates):** Women's health physiotherapy, pelvic floor, **prenatal and postnatal** rehab, musculoskeletal care for women, **Mat Pilates online**, **STOTT Pilates on Mat and Reformer**, wellness programs — **online classes and guidance** for international clients; in person in **Bangalore** and **Ahmedabad**.
- **Delivery:** **Online-first worldwide** (video visits from India); many **city** overview pages plus **service-by-city** pages under `/online-consultation/...` (lists highlight common metros only—**many more cities worldwide** are welcome the same way). Dedicated India city pages (e.g. Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Bengaluru) describe local access.

## Discovery & indexing (production)

- **Canonical site:** `https://womenshealthduo.com` (no trailing slash in env defaults).
- **Robots:** [`/robots.txt`](https://womenshealthduo.com/robots.txt) — allows major search and common AI crawlers; references the sitemap URL.
- **Sitemap:** [`/sitemap.xml`](https://womenshealthduo.com/sitemap.xml) — generated at **`npm run build`** from `SITEMAP_PATHS` in `src/config/routes.ts` (homepage, doctor profiles, India city landings, **Learn hub main + every indexable doctor/topic filter URL**, FAQ, virtual hub, per-country hubs, every virtual city overview, and every **service × city** URL). Each URL includes **`<lastmod>`** (build date) and a **priority** hint (hub and core pages higher than long-tail service×city pages).
- **HTML head:** root [`index.html`](https://womenshealthduo.com/) receives build-time tokens for title, description, **meta keywords** (comma-separated topics for legacy crawlers), Open Graph, and a **`<link rel="sitemap">`** to the absolute sitemap URL.

## URL patterns (Learn hub — video Shorts & Reels)

- **All clips:** `/learn`
- **By doctor:** `/learn/dr-charmi`, `/learn/dr-zalak`
- **By topic:** `/learn/topic/<topicSlug>` (slug from topic label, e.g. `fertility`, `labor-and-delivery`, `pilates`)
- **Doctor + topic:** `/learn/<doctorSegment>/topic/<topicSlug>` (e.g. `/learn/dr-zalak/topic/pregnancy`)

## URL patterns (virtual SEO)

- **Hub:** `/online-consultation`
- **Country index:** `/online-consultation/country/<countrySlug>` (e.g. `india`, `united-states`)
- **City overview:** `/online-consultation/<citySlug>` (e.g. `dubai`, `london`, `toronto`)
- **Service × city:** `/online-consultation/<citySlug>/<serviceSlug>` — one page per combination for long-tail discovery.
- **Legacy:** `/global-online` redirects to `/online-consultation` (preserve old bookmarks).

## Online service slugs (`<serviceSlug>`)

These repeat under every virtual city (see `src/data/seoOnlineServices.ts` in the repository): `pregnancy-high-risk-obstetrics`, `ivf-fertility-treatments`, `laparoscopic-surgery`, `pcos-hormonal-disorders`, `gynecological-care`, `menopause-wellness`, `pelvic-floor-rehabilitation`, `antenatal-postnatal-care`, `mat-pilates-online`, `stott-pilates`, `musculoskeletal-physiotherapy`, `core-functional-training`, `womens-wellness-programs`.

## Topics & queries this site is built for

- **OB-GYN / IVF (Dr. Charmi):** pregnancy & high-risk obstetrics, gynecology, IVF/IUI discussion, laparoscopy-related consults, PCOS/endometriosis, menopause, routine women's health — **telehealth from India** for NRIs and global families; **in person** in **Mumbai** and **Ahmedabad**.
- **Physio / Pilates (Dr. Zalak):** pelvic floor, **prenatal and postnatal** care, **Mat Pilates online**, STOTT **Mat & Reformer**, MSK physio, core/functional training, wellness-style programs — **online-first** worldwide; **in person** in **Bangalore** and **Ahmedabad**.
- **Languages often used on consults:** English, Hindi, Gujarati (request when you message).
- **Booking:** WhatsApp and email on the site; not emergency services.

## Note for site owners

If the live domain differs, update `VITE_SITE_URL` in `.env`, `src/config/site.defaults.ts` (`SITE_DEFAULT_URL`), and this file so links stay accurate. Marketing URLs live in `src/config/routes.ts`, `src/lib/virtualConsultation.ts`, `src/data/seoOnlineServices.ts`, and `src/data/virtualConsultationCities.json`; `dist/sitemap.xml` lists them at build time. Legacy `/global-online` URLs redirect to `/online-consultation`.
